text:
carmen: quick sync  were shipping a small opt-in for a structured routing header `X-RI-Route-Broker` (JSON blob). goal: centralize route matching + quota hints. SDK owners: need minimal compatibility.

vishal: is this additive? will we keep `Route-Hint`?

carmen: additive. broker wins if present; fallback to `Route-Hint`. plan canary @5% traffic.

mai: SDK surface suggestion: new param `route_broker` accepts string|object. if string, wrap to {"route": <string>}. add `enable_route_broker` flag default false and an env var `REDWOOD_ENABLE_ROUTE_BROKER`. emit telemetry `sdk.route_broker.sent`.

vishal: also emit `sdk.route_broker.coerced` when we wrap strings so console can find apps that need changing. include a stable per-install `client_id` (opaque) in payload for trace joins. no PII.

ops-bot: console needs two tiles: "Broker adoption" and "Quota delta". ingestion will accept `sdk.route_broker.sent` events; tag traces with `client_id`.

carmen: server will add `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` (internal) that echoes parsed payload to aid debugging.

deploy-bot: scheduled: route-broker v0.1-canary -> infra-canary @ 03:30 UTC. rollback if 5xx > 1.8x OR quota mismatch > 3% in first 15m.

mai: semver plan = minor bumps only. will open py/go/ts PRs with tests + examples. add a single deprecation log on first send and a warning metric when coercion occurs.

vishal: i'll draft runbook thresholds and dashboard filters.

carmen: action items: mai -> SDK PRs, vishal -> runbook & dashboard, ops-bot -> telemetry mapping. keep PRs tiny. :thumbsup:

mai: ack

(End)
